company.shortDescription: Infinite Machine is to create the world's most captivating non-auto vehicles.
company.description: Infinite Machine is to create the world's most captivating non-auto vehicles. Infinite Machine initial product, the P1, is a revolutionary new personal electric vehicle that combines innovative performance and usefulness with an industrial-style look. In Infinite Machine's ideal post-car future, environment and people coexist together.

productsAndServices.description: A two-passenger electric motorcycle for city and car-lane travel, with a 6 kW motor, 65 mph top speed, and approximately 60 miles of real-world urban range.
productsAndServices.name: P1

productsAndServices.description: A two-passenger Class 2 electric vehicle designed for bike lanes, offering pedal assist and throttle operation, a 20 mph top speed, and approximately 35 miles of range.
productsAndServices.name: Olto

productsAndServices.description: A commercial vehicle program for deploying Infinite Machine vehicles across hospitality, last-mile delivery, law enforcement, and shared-campus operations.
productsAndServices.name: Fleet Deployment

productsAndServices.description: A partner program for authorized dealers to sell and support P1 and Olto vehicles, with wholesale pricing, marketing resources, training, warranty support, and dedicated account management.
productsAndServices.name: Dealer Program

productsAndServices.description: Post-sale support for Infinite Machine vehicles, including limited warranty coverage, nationwide service partners, mobile repairs, self-service guides, spare parts, and software updates.
productsAndServices.name: Vehicle Service and Warranty Support

productsAndServices.description: Scheduled and walk-in demonstrations of Infinite Machine vehicles at company showrooms and pop-up locations, allowing prospective customers to ride and evaluate P1 and Olto.
productsAndServices.name: Test Ride Experience
